lines.intro1: Captain! Mission Control wants a flight test before we fly any further.
lines.intro2: The questions get harder the higher we fly. When it gets too tricky, that's fine. It shows us where your missions should start.
lines.how: Type your answer, then press the green button.
lines.miss2: Ooh, that one's hard. No problem.
lines.harder: Wow, you're flying high. These get harder now.
lines.end1: Flight test complete! What a pilot.
lines.end2: Mission Control has your level. Your next missions will start right there.
lines.q_t1a: Seven cells. How many more to make ten?
lines.q_t1b: Four cells. How many more to make ten?
lines.q_t1c: Eight cells. How many more to make ten?
lines.q_t5a: Three pods. Five cells in each. How many altogether?
lines.q_t5b: Four pods. Two cells in each. How many altogether?
lines.q_t5c: Six pods. Ten cells in each. How many altogether?
lines.q_t6a: Each tube holds ten. How many cells altogether?
lines.q_t7a: What number, add six, makes fifteen?
lines.q_t7b: Twenty take away what number makes thirteen?
lines.q_t7c: Eight add what number makes seventeen?
lines.q_t9a: Share twelve cells between two astronauts. How many each?
lines.q_t9b: Share eight cells between four astronauts. How many each?
